sentences.en: It also features four different formats for obtaining the music including PDF, GIF, ABC and Midi files to give an aural reference for the player.

sentences.en: Symbolism means the use of an symbol, whether in a visual or aural way, to represent another meaning.

sentences.en: Coursework will involve aural analysis and exercises in jazz harmony that may lead to composition.
